sections.body: ReSTIR, large-graph level-of-detail rendering, and skeleton-based edge bundling all use image-space or GPU-friendly aggregation to make large rendering or visualization problems interactive.
sections.heading: Aggregation pattern

sections.body: The shared concept is not a single algorithm but a design pattern: compress many candidates, nodes, or edges into compact screen-space summaries, then operate on those summaries instead of carrying full explicit structure through every step.
sections.heading: Compact summaries

sections.body: A useful page could contrast reservoirs, accumulation fields, pixel-bin seed points, density fields, and CUDA image-space transforms, while noting that each method has different information-loss and correlation assumptions.
sections.heading: Method contrasts
